scope: Field-level confirmed soil/task corrections only. Prepared for root to apply with before-value checks; this manifest has not changed any seeds or production records.
patch_format: Top-level field name, or traits.soil.value.text.<language>. before_missing distinguishes an absent translation from an explicit null.

air-plant.definition_en: A mounted or supported air plant grown without potting soil, with free airflow. Not a conventional compost.

aquatic.definition_en: Specialist aquatic compost or suitable heavy loam, used in a species-appropriate submerged or marginal container. Not ordinary houseplant compost.

carnivorous-bog.definition_en: Specialist acidic, low-nutrient medium for the named bog carnivores; no pre-added fertilizer. Do not assume suitability for every carnivorous genus.

nepenthes.definition_en: Airy, low-nutrient sphagnum-based medium with suitable porous components for tropical pitcher plants, not stagnant bog compost.

pinguicula.definition_en: Airy, low-nutrient mineral-rich medium for the named Mexican butterwort, without pre-added fertilizer. Distinct from acidic bog mixes.
